title: The Secret of a Humble Heart
story:
A famous scientist visited a classroom to answer children's questions.

Many students tried to impress him with difficult words and complicated ideas.

One little boy simply raised his hand and asked,

"Can you explain it in a way I can understand?"

The scientist smiled and patiently explained everything using simple examples.

The boy left the classroom understanding far more than those who only wanted to appear knowledgeable.

True wisdom begins with humility.

Jesus thanked the Father because His truths were revealed, not to those who trusted in their own wisdom, but to those with humble, childlike hearts.

God is not looking for people who know everything.

He delights in teaching those who are willing to learn.

When we come before Him with humility, He opens our minds to understand His Word and His will.
life_lesson: God gladly reveals His truth to those who approach Him with humility, trust, and a teachable heart.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being a loving Teacher.

Give me a humble heart that is eager to learn from You.

Remove pride from my life and help me to depend on Your wisdom instead of my own understanding.

Open my eyes to know Your truth and follow Your will every day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you willing to let God teach you, even when it means setting aside your own ideas?

What is one area where you need His wisdom today?

How can you cultivate a humble, childlike faith?
verse: At that time Jesus said, 'I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what You were pleased to do.'
